jobs.description_text: ABOUT ACT There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. ROLE - Build and maintain production iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI - Develop interfaces for messaging, real-time communication and AI-powered features - Integrate backend APIs, including streaming responses, asynchronous operations and error handling - Implement local storage, push notifications, background tasks and data synchronisation - Optimise application performance, startup time, memory usage and battery consumption - Implement analytics, crash reporting and monitoring to identify and resolve production issues - Work with backend, ML and design teams to develop, test and release new features REQUIREMENTS - 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift, with applications shipped to the App Store - Strong understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, iOS SDK and application lifecycle - Experience with Swift concurrency, async/await, background processing and asynchronous data handling - Experience integrating REST APIs, managing local data and handling network failures - Understanding of iOS architecture patterns, state management and memory management - Experience profiling and optimising application performance using Xcode Instruments - Strong debugging skills and experience maintaining production iOS applications NICE TO HAVE - Experience building messaging, chat or real-time communication applications - Experience integrating LLM, speech, vision or other AI-powered APIs - Experience with Core ML or on-device machine learning - Experience with feature flags, remote configuration or automated iOS release pipelines

jobs.description_text: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. THE ROLE We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Finance Agent. This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Build customer-facing and internal product features end to end. - Develop web flows, backend APIs, admin tools, dashboards and operational systems. - Support products across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and financial services. - Work with product, design, mobile and operations teams to launch fast. - Integrate APIs, handle data flows and improve production reliability. - Use analytics, feedback and production issues to improve features after launch. - Help build tools that reduce manual work and improve speed across the business. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3+ years of full stack software engineering experience. - Strong frontend and backend fundamentals. - Experience with modern web frameworks, APIs, databases and production systems. - Able to build useful products quickly without needing perfect specs. - Good product sense, UX awareness and attention to detail. - Comfortable debugging across the stack. - Experience in fintech, insurtech, marketplace, consumer apps or high-volume platforms is a strong advantage. THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT - Can turn rough requirements into working product. - Thinks about user flow, backend logic and business process together. - Moves fast while keeping systems maintainable. - Takes ownership from build to launch to post-launch fixes. - Clear about what they personally built and what was team-owned. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR - Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer. - People who need complete specs before starting. - Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact. - Candidates who avoid production support. - People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work. LOCATION This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Singapore. LANGUAGE English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. INTERVIEW PROCESS Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description_text:
Capco

Capco is a leading global technology and management consultancy that excels in driving digital transformation within the financial services and insurance sectors. With an unwavering commitment to delivering practical solutions, we empower our clients to navigate the complexities of today's fast-paced market. Our integrated services span across major financial hubs worldwide, ensuring that we are always close to our clients and their needs.

At Capco, we possess not only the expertise but also the vision and passion necessary to lead transformative change. As we embark on an exciting growth journey, this is the perfect moment to join our team. We are expanding geographically, increasing our workforce, and poised to disrupt the consulting landscape across APAC with our entrepreneurial spirit and agile methodologies.

About the Role

We are thrilled to introduce an opportunity for a talented AI Engineer to join our Singapore team. This role is designed for a technology innovator who thrives on solving complex challenges and is passionate about building AI-driven solutions that transform the Financial Services industry. As an AI Engineer at Capco, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of insurance by leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies to deliver intelligent, scalable, and compliant solutions. Your work will enable our clients to unlock new efficiencies, enhance customer experience, and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. If you are excited about applying advanced AI techniques to real-world business problems and driving measurable impact, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build multi-agent workflows to optimize business processes within insurance.
  • Develop and maintain software pipelines for data processing, model training, and deployment using Python-based frameworks.
  • Train, fine-tune, and optimize neural network models, including LLMs, for specific use cases such as risk assessment and customer query resolution.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready AI applications.
  • Ensure AI models adhere to banking regulations, data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and ethical AI practices.
  • Monitor deployed solutions in production, troubleshooting issues, and implement updates as needed.
  • Strong experience delivering production-grade applications, backend services and technical components that support data, workflow, automation or AI-driven solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and CI/CD processes.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 3–12 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with a focus on software development and deployment.
  • Build and integrate components for LLM, RAG, search, agent-based and automation solutions,
  • Strong software engineering experience with Python, Java, React Next, Node.js
  • Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning neural network models, with a track record of optimizing for performance and scalability.
  • Proven expertise working with LLMs (e.g., GPT, BERT) and building agentic solutions using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or ADK.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) for model deployment and data management.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, and bias mitigation.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services domains
  • Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Knowledge of graph databases and knowledge graphs.
  • Understanding DevOps practices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and MLOps workflows.
  • Publications, open-source contributions, or certifications in AI/ML.
  • Strong communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

ELIGIBILITY TO WORK IN SG

Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore. Only Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents (PRs) will be considered. Employment Pass sponsorship is not available for this role.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join an engineering team at an AI infrastructure company focused on reinforcement learning environments and evaluation. You will build systems that make quality control for training data scalable, helping improve the reliability of data used to train and evaluate AI agents. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Automate quality control for training data generated through the platform. - Build quality systems grounded in human judgment and understanding, rather than relying heavily on large language models. - Define and enforce standards for training data quality. - Design experiments and metrics to evaluate agent outputs. - Work with data vendors to investigate quality issues, diagnose agent failure modes, and improve data generation processes. - Turn quality findings into sampling strategies and rule-based or model-assisted validation pipelines. - Incorporate quality insights into infrastructure tools and vendor workflows to reduce anomalies and edge cases. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in research engineering or a related technical role, especially in quality control automation. - A technical degree and proficiency with Python, Docker, and Linux. - Experience independently building scalable data validation pipelines and end-to-end automated QA or QC systems. - Experience with benchmarks and evaluations for reinforcement learning data, including realistic task design, reliable rubrics, and useful training trajectories. - Ability to define and measure training data quality, and design QC systems that use human judgment without heavy reliance on large language models. - Experience designing evaluation metrics and experiments, and collaborating with data vendors to resolve quality problems. - Knowledge of statistics, strong communication skills, curiosity, and comfort working independently in an early-stage environment. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary range: $100,000 to $170,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.
jobs.title: Research Engineer, QC Automation

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join a small, technical AI evaluation team building rigorous benchmarks for frontier AI agents. You will own the design and implementation of domain-specific evaluations that help research teams and customers understand how agents perform on realistic workflows. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, implement, and maintain internal benchmarks for evaluating frontier agents on domain-specific tasks. - Partner with subject-matter experts to translate real-world workflows into benchmark tasks and evaluation criteria. - Build reliable infrastructure to run models and agents against benchmark tasks at scale. - Develop metrics and analyses to assess benchmark difficulty, reliability, and failure modes. - Validate whether benchmark results align with real-world evaluations and user needs. - Write clear technical documentation and reports explaining benchmark methods and results. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or research engineering, including at least two years building AI benchmarks, evaluation infrastructure, or agent environments. - Technical education or strong fundamentals in a technical field. - Proficiency with Python, Docker, and Linux for research or production infrastructure. - Hands-on experience designing and operating evaluations or environments for AI agents or large language models. - Experience building reliable model or agent execution infrastructure, developing evaluation metrics or statistical analyses, and validating benchmark performance. - Ability to work with subject-matter experts and understand workflows across technical or business domains. - Strong technical writing, attention to detail, independent problem-solving, and comfort in an early-stage environment. - Published research or technical writing on AI benchmarks, evaluation methods, or model failure modes is valued. Reinforcement learning pipelines, data generation, and agent evaluation experience are also relevant. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join a small engineering team at an AI company focused on reinforcement learning environments, model evaluation, and post-training data. You will tackle urgent, ambiguous technical challenges for AI labs and data vendors, while turning repeated deployment work into reusable tools. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own technical deployment requests from initial triage through resolution. - Diagnose ambiguous technical problems and clarify what needs to be done. - Build tools and one-off pipelines to address urgent customer and partner needs. - Coordinate with research, go-to-market, and other internal teams to unblock deployments. - Balance speed and quality, escalating when correctness or security requires extra care. - Document recurring issues and convert manual work into reusable tools and processes. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in applied research engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. - Research engineering experience alongside customer-facing deployment work, including ownership of requests from triage to completion. - Proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux, with strong debugging skills across code, data, and environments. - Experience with benchmarks and evaluations for reinforcement learning training data and AI agents, including assessing task realism, rubric reliability, and useful training trajectories. - Ability to build practical tools and pipelines, work directly with technical customers or vendors, and handle urgent production or deployment issues. - Strong independent judgment in ambiguous situations, clear communication across time zones, and experience in an early-stage startup environment. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join a small engineering team building synthetic data systems for AI agents. You will turn domain-specific workflows into scalable training tasks, helping improve how models learn and perform in real-world applications. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build pipelines that convert professional and technical workflows into realistic, structured training tasks. - Collaborate with subject-matter experts to develop tasks across distinct domains. - Design methods for generating diverse, realistic, and learnable synthetic tasks. - Create tools to mutate, validate, and improve generated tasks. - Analyze agent performance to understand task effectiveness and identify failure modes. - Develop metrics for task diversity, realism, learnability, and overall quality. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two or more years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI research, building and delivering data pipelines, ML infrastructure, or synthetic data systems. - Technical education or equivalent technical background, with strong Python skills and experience in Linux environments and Docker. - Hands-on experience applying synthetic data methods to build end-to-end generation pipelines for AI or machine learning. - Understanding of synthetic data quality, evaluation criteria, and limitations. - Experience building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or testing environments for AI agents or large language models. - Ability to independently deliver projects in open-ended settings, with careful attention to data quality and edge cases. - Familiarity with reinforcement learning, agent workflows, or LLM post-training is valuable. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Annual base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT US: Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. THE ROLE: As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you will serve as a vital bridge between cutting-edge AI research and practical, real-world applications. Your work will focus on developing, fine-tuning, and operationalizing machine learning models that drive business value and enhance user experiences. This is a hands-on engineering role that combines deep technical expertise with a strong customer focus to deliver scalable AI solutions. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Customer Success: Collaborate directly with the GTM team (Account Executives and Solutions Architects) to ensure smooth integration and successful deployment of ML solutions. - Demo / Proof of Concept (PoC): Build and present compelling PoCs that demonstrate the capabilities of our AI technology. - Application Build: Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI-powered applications tailored to customer needs. - Platform Features / Bug Fixes: Contribute to the internal ML platform, including adding features and resolving issues. - New Model Enablements: Integrate and enable new machine learning models into the existing platform or client environments. - Performance Optimizations: Improve system performance, efficiency, and scalability of deployed models and applications. - Partnership Enablement: Work closely with partners to enable joint AI solutions and ensure seamless collaboration. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. - 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with a strong preference for customer-facing roles. - Robust coding skills required, preferably with proficiency in Python. - Demonstrated ability to lead and execute complex technical projects with a focus on customer success. - Strong interpersonal and communication skills; ability to thrive in dynamic, cross-functional teams. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: - Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. - Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment. - Hands-on experience fine-tuning machine learning models, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF or RFT). - Solid understanding of generative AI, machine learning principles, and enterprise infrastructure. WHY FIREWORKS? - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving. - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally. - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results. - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation. Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.
